context: Sakura and Hiroshi-elder discuss a documentary on a national event.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: documentary discussion; formal vocabulary in natural home.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: おとうさん、この番組、国家の政策の話ですね。
lines.en: Otosan, this program is about national policy.
lines.style: soft adult writer voice, warm engaged delivery carefully

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: おう、全国に、影響した出来事やな。
lines.en: Yeah — an event that affected the whole country.
lines.style: slow elder Kansai voice, warm thoughtful delivery carefully

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: その時代における判断、難しかったでしょうね。
lines.en: The decisions of that era must have been hard.
lines.style: gentle adult writer voice, soft warm reflective delivery carefully

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 専門家も、いくつか問題を指摘しとったな。
lines.en: Experts pointed out several problems too.
lines.style: gentle elder Kansai voice, soft warm informative delivery carefully

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 完全に理解するのは、難しいですね。
lines.en: It's hard to understand it completely.
lines.style: soft adult writer voice, warm honest delivery carefully

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: こうやって、学ぶのが大事や。
lines.en: Learning like this is what matters.
lines.style: warm elder Kansai voice, soft warm wise delivery carefully

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: また、一緒に観ましょう。
lines.style: tender adult writer voice, soft warm fond delivery carefully
